sections_target.text: Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, to be performed every six months or when damages occur on any part of it as indicated by M6 in the title block
These cranes are used at Turbine Hall for dismantling and erection of turbines and for maintenance works
Technical specifications for 10 Ton (2 Cranes)
Technical specifications for 265 Ton Cranes (2 x 132.5/30)

The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Saber Ibrahem, tested by eng. Mohamed Hafez Abdel Meniem, accepted by general director eng. Abdel Ghaffar Osman Ahmed, and approved by eng. Mohamed Abd Elbast; Head Sector of Aswan ( 1 & 2 ) Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb: HPGC quality control General Manager and MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, belts, work gloves
Turn off all power to crane before proceeding

sections_target.text: Tools and Equipment
Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.
Torque wrench, wrench with different sizes, pressure grease gun and feeler gauge
Cleaning articles ( fluid , rags , .. Etc )
Mobilgear 634 oil , Esso surrett Nx 5k gears

items: Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.
Torque wrench, wrench with different sizes, pressure grease gun and feeler gauge
Cleaning articles ( fluid , rags , .. Etc )
Mobilgear 634 oil , Esso surrett Nx 5k gears

sections_target.text: Work to be Done
Check brake lining for wear and tear and if 2 mm thick above or under rivets should be changed
Examine for broken wire strands
Examine rope securing points and rope guide.
Grease rope with Esso surrett Nx 5k.
Check oil level of gear boxes and refill if necessary with Mobilgear 634 oil.
Inspect and check tightness of bolts, nuts.
Examine the condition of flanges and anti-friction bearing seals.
Examine the structural steelwork to make sure there is no rust or corrosion and repaint it if necessary.
Check rings and bushings for wear and tear.
Check tightness of coupling, screws.
Clean bearings and lubricat it with Mobilux Ep4 grease.
Examine gears for main hoist, axial travel and cross travel which in open boxes and grease it with Esso surrett Nx 5k grease.
Operate the crane for test.
Place a copy of the field test results at the equipment data file.

Footer reads 'Crane شفرة:' – 'شفرة' rendered as 'code'; the intended field label is unclear (possibly 'Crane code:').
